notes.title: Don't Wake Grandpa Update 1.5 (Bug Fixes & Stability Update)
notes.content:
[u][b]Changes & Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]

Menu Pausing Stability Fixes.

Added facial animations to Grandpas Jumps scare.

Added 12 new videos to the TV for extra variety.

Fixed an issue where Night Select would load the night from the player's save file instead of the night they selected.

Various other bug fixes.

[b][i]Known Issues:[/i][/b]
Pausing on night select during phone calls might cause some issues.

notes.title: Don’t Wake Grandma, DLC 1 Teaser Tailer
Don’t Wake Grandpa Update 1
notes.content:
Update 1 Update introduces a new challenging Night, taking place after the events of "Don’t Wake Grandma" (Coming soon as a free DLC—be on the lookout for that!) That brings new gameplay mechanics and more action!

Update 1 Also adds two new fun modes:

Free Watch Tv Mode
Endless Night Mode
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Also includes, 

Night Selection: Once you beat all 5 regular nights, you can select a specific night to revisit and play!

Little Updates:  

Night 1 and Night 2 Are Quicker To Complete.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

More To Come Soon In Update 2!

notes.title: Update 1 + dlc 1 + More Coming Soon!!
notes.content:
🎉 Announcement: Don't Wake Grandpa - Update 1 + FREE DLC Coming Soon! 🎉

🧓👵 FREE DLC: Don’t Wake Grandma!

Introducing Don't Wake Grandma: This exciting new DLC is completely FREE with Update 1!
New Gameplay Mechanics: Grandma has her own unique treats and challenges, providing a fresh spin on the game.

Timeline: Set after the events of Night 5, Grandma has surprises that will keep you guessing!

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
🌙 NEW GAME MODE: Endless Night

Challenge Yourself: Think you’ve mastered the game? Dive into Endless Night Mode, where the gameplay is similar to Night 5 but never ends.
Intense Gameplay: This mode offers a thrilling experience with faster and more unpredictable gameplay.
Set Your High Score: How long can you survive without waking Grandma? Compete for the ultimate high score!

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


📺 FREE WATCH TV MODE

Take a Break: Need to unwind? The Free Watch TV Mode lets you enjoy in-game television without the stress of waking anyone up.

Relax and Enjoy: No worries—just sit back and channel surf!
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

🌙 NEW NIGHT 6

Get Ready for Night 6: A fresh challenge awaits you, featuring new surprises and gameplay elements!
A New Treat: We have something special in store, but we won’t tell you who it is... Who could it be???

notes.title: "Don't Wake Grandma" – Free DLC Coming Soon!
notes.content: We're excited to announce the upcoming free DLC, "Don't Wake Grandma"! Get ready to dive into new challenges, fresh gameplay mechanics, and thrilling experiences as Grandma enters the picture. This DLC will be available soon at no additional cost, so keep an eye out for updates.

notes.title: Don't Wake Grandpa - Official Release on October 4th!
notes.content: "Don't Wake Grandpa" will officially release on October 4th. Dive into a thrilling night of survival, resource management, and supernatural suspense. Keep the noise down, Deal with deadly threats, and most importantly—don't wake grandpa!
